evals.name: eval-1-habit-specific
evals.prompt: 습관 트래커 앱을 만들려고 해. 인터랙티브 시안부터 확정하고 개발 들어갈 거야. 각 화면은 내 승인 받고 다음으로 넘어갈 거니까 시안은 html로 만들어줘. 일단 첫 실행 흐름만: 이름 입력 → 만들고 싶은 습관 고르기 → 첫 체크 완료까지. https://rive.app 의 살아있는 캐릭터 모션에서 영감 받고 싶어. 습관을 고르면 작은 씨앗들이 화면에 심어지고, 첫 체크를 하면 그게 싹트는 느낌이었으면 좋겠어.
evals.expected_output: Builds only the requested first-run flow (3-5 screens), not a whole app; Has a signature moment tied to the product (seeds planted on pick, sprouting on first check); Extracts principles from the reference rather than copying it, and credits it; Checks motion over time (filmstrip / frames) and the audit has 0 errors; Creates DESIGN_NOTES.md with a flow map / direction; Stops after the flow and asks for approval before continuing; No generic AI look: no emoji icons, no purple default, no swipe-carousel onboarding; Korean UI copy in 해요체
assertions: Builds only the requested first-run flow (3-5 screens), not a whole app
Has a signature moment tied to the product (seeds planted on pick, sprouting on first check)
Extracts principles from the reference rather than copying it, and credits it
Checks motion over time (filmstrip / frames) and the audit has 0 errors
Creates DESIGN_NOTES.md with a flow map / direction
Stops after the flow and asks for approval before continuing
No generic AI look: no emoji icons, no purple default, no swipe-carousel onboarding
Korean UI copy in 해요체

evals.name: eval-2-dogwalk-thin
evals.prompt: 반려견 산책 기록 앱 시안 만들어줘
evals.expected_output: Does not build a full multi-screen app straight away; Proposes 2-3 directions or concepts concisely, with a recommendation; Proposes signature-moment ideas tied to dog walking (not generic decoration); Lays out the flow map / first flow screens; Asks at most 3 questions and waits for the user
assertions: Does not build a full multi-screen app straight away
Proposes 2-3 directions or concepts concisely, with a recommendation
Proposes signature-moment ideas tied to dog walking (not generic decoration)
Lays out the flow map / first flow screens
Asks at most 3 questions and waits for the user

evals.name: eval-3-continue
evals.prompt: examples/umteum 에 있는 습관 트래커 시안 이어서 해줘. 첫 실행 흐름은 승인됐어. 다음은 알림 권한이랑 체크 시간 정하는 흐름 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing DESIGN_NOTES and keeps the same visual language (fonts, palette, seed characters); Builds only the notification flow, leaving the approved first-run flow intact; Handles Android specifics (POST_NOTIFICATIONS on API 33+, rationale before the system dialog, denial path to settings); Has a signature moment that explains why notifications help (not a plain system-dialog wall); Checks motion (frames) and the audit has 0 errors; Stops for approval; does not mark the flow approved in DESIGN_NOTES before the user approves; Korean UI copy consistent with the first-run tone
assertions: Reads the existing DESIGN_NOTES and keeps the same visual language (fonts, palette, seed characters)
Builds only the notification flow, leaving the approved first-run flow intact
Handles Android specifics (POST_NOTIFICATIONS on API 33+, rationale before the system dialog, denial path to settings)
Has a signature moment that explains why notifications help (not a plain system-dialog wall)
Checks motion (frames) and the audit has 0 errors
Stops for approval; does not mark the flow approved in DESIGN_NOTES before the user approves
Korean UI copy consistent with the first-run tone
